entries.description: Ground educational explanations in approved research.
entries.full_clause_review: Educational output is restricted to complete original research paragraphs whose every source passes isApprovedForDisplay; notes require eligibility, actual hormone match and nonempty own sources. UI displays exact heading/source records and explicit coverage limits. No model-generated clinical prose is introduced.

entries.description: Do not automatically share measurements with Ask.
entries.full_clause_review: Default measurement/category selections are empty. Picker toggles only a local unsent set; selection without attachment/send never invokes Ask. Send snapshots selected records only, clears selections for the next question, rechecks current bytes and cancels on changed records/lifecycle. Engine accepts optional explicit context and never reads the measurement store itself.

entries.description: Require explicit user action before sharing measurements in Ask.
entries.full_clause_review: Sharing requires attach my context, choosing actual IDs/categories, attach selected context, then Send. Picker starts with caller selections, filters removed IDs, validates size and returns explicit choices; Send consumes one question snapshot, detects edits before submission and never inserts private fields into evidence/citations or saved-answer metadata.
